# LibreNotes

> A private, offline-first markdown notes app for Android and Linux. Notes are end-to-end encrypted on your device and optionally synced to a server you host yourself. No accounts, no cloud, no trackers, no subscriptions. Free and open source (AGPLv3).

LibreNotes works fully on its own. To use the same notes on several devices, run the small sync server on your home network or a private mesh such as Tailscale or WireGuard. The server only ever stores ciphertext, so it cannot read your notes. Conflicts are never auto-merged: when two devices edit the same note, you pick the winner.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://librenotes.ayopili.com/docs): what LibreNotes is and how sync is optional
- [Install the app](https://librenotes.ayopili.com/docs/install): Android and Linux
- [Set up sync](https://librenotes.ayopili.com/docs/sync-setup): run the server with Docker or systemd, connect the app, add HTTPS
- [Encryption & privacy](https://librenotes.ayopili.com/docs/encryption): XChaCha20-Poly1305 note encryption, Argon2id passphrase key derivation
- [Troubleshooting](https://librenotes.ayopili.com/docs/troubleshooting)
